name: zachary
note: Zachary 1977. The canonical community-detection benchmark; max known modularity 0.4198.

name: florentine
note: Padgett & Ansell 1993. Small and disconnected-adjacent: good for edge cases.

name: davis
note: Davis 1941. Bipartite, so community structure is a known trap.

name: lesmis
note: Knuth 1993. Weighted co-appearance graph; exercises the weighted paths.

name: petersen
note: Vertex-transitive: every node has identical centrality, so any asymmetry is a bug.

name: star_10
note: Closed form: hub betweenness = (n-1)(n-2)/2 = 36. Checkable by hand.

name: path_10
note: Closed form for distances and betweenness. Checkable by hand.

name: complete_8
note: All betweenness zero, all distances 1. Degenerate on purpose.

name: grid_4x4
note: Regular lattice with no community structure: guards against inventing one.

name: ring_of_cliques_10x5
note: Fortunato & Barthelemy 2007 resolution limit. Ground truth is the 10 cliques.

name: disjoint_cliques
note: Three separated cliques. Exact expected partition, not an envelope.
